Population increased in South Staffordshire

The estimated population of South Staffordshire in 2024 was 114,423 usual residents, a rise of 0.9% since 2023.

This meant that South Staffordshire's rate of population change placed it about average among local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of South Staffordshire increased by 3.3%.

Over this slightly longer period, South Staffordshire was also among the areas that had a broadly average population increase, of local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of South Staffordshire

The average (median) age fell to 48 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of South Staffordshire has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
South Staffordshire is an area that is classed as intermediate rural in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, South Staffordshire's population of 114,423 usual residents was made up of:

  • 17,906 people aged 0 to 15 years, (15.6%)
  • 66,950 people aged 16 to 64 years, (58.5%)
  • 29,567 people aged 65 years and over, (25.8%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, South Staffordshire has a higher proportion of people aged 65 years and over (25.8% compared with 18.9% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In South Staffordshire, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net internal migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in South Staffordshire
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for South Staffordshire, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More deaths than births led to a fall in the population of 559 people (-0.5%). In total, there were 797 births and 1,356 deaths in South Staffordshire.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 1,301 (1.1%). There were 6,785 people entering the area and 5,484 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in South Staffordshire's population of 179 (0.2%) as a result of 264 people entering the area and 85 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for South Staffordshire was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of South Staffordshire in mid-2023 is 113,412.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 108 people and internal migration estimates were revised upwards by 216 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 324 people.
